summary: Momentus Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of an Equity Purchase Agreement with Yield Point NY LLC, originally entered September 25, 2025, and amended December 23, 2025. The facility allowed Momentus, at its discretion, to direct the investor to purchase up to $50,000,000 in Class A common stock. On August 21, 2026, Momentus gave notice under Section 10.6 to terminate, effective that date. The company had not utilized the facility and incurred no termination penalties. This is a routine contract termination, not a special situation. No deal terms are stated beyond the $50M facility amount.
